استنيئوا (form X)
# اُسْتُنِيئُوا (ustunīʔū) /us.tu.niː.ʔuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنَاءَ (istanāʔa)
# اِسْتَنِيئُوا (istanīʔū) /is.ta.niː.ʔuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنَاءَ (istanāʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
